title: GreenDynaMix: Thermal-Aware Dynamic Mixed-Precision MoE LLM Inference Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.31737v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sustained Large Language Model (LLM) inference generates significant heat that exacerbates silicon aging and reduces GPU reliability. Because GPU temperature fluctuates continuously with workload intensity and ambient conditions, keeping it in a safe range requires real-time frequency scaling, which inevitably comes at the cost of either throughput or accuracy. To address this tightly coupled challenge, we propose GreenDynaMix, the first runtime system to jointly integrate a DVFS-based thermal manager with a dynamic precision-tuning throughput compensator. A sensitivity-aware allocator leverages intrinsic importance signals from the Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) router to assign higher precision to critical experts, preserving accuracy. Experiments on server, desktop, and embedded platforms demonstrate that GreenDynaMix reduces the temperature-induced aging rate of GPUs during LLM inference by 25-33%. translated_title: GreenDynaMix：温度感知的动态混合精度MoE大语言模型推理系统
translated_abstract: 持续的大语言模型（LLM）推理会产生大量热量，加剧硅片老化并降低GPU的可靠性。由于GPU温度会随工作负载强度和环境条件持续波动，将其保持在安全范围内需要实时频率调节，而这不可避免地会以吞吐量或精度为代价。为解决这一紧密耦合的挑战，我们提出了GreenDynaMix，这是首个将基于DVFS的温度管理器与动态精度调优吞吐量补偿器联合集成的运行时系统。一个敏感性感知分配器利用来自混合专家路由器的内在重要性信号，为关键专家分配更高的精度，从而保持准确性。在服务器、台式机和嵌入式平台上的实验表明，GreenDynaMix将LLM推理过程中温度引起的GPU老化率降低了25-33%，且无需离线剖析或模型再训练。
tldr: GreenDynaMix是首个将DVFS温度管理与动态混合精度调优相结合的运行时系统，它利用MoE路由器的重要性信号为关键专家分配更高精度，在降低GPU热老化率25-33%的同时保持了推理精度。
en_tdlr: GreenDynaMix is the first runtime system that jointly integrates DVFS-based thermal management with dynamic mixed-precision tuning, leveraging MoE router importance signals to assign higher precision to critical experts, reducing temperature-induced GPU aging by 25-33% while preserving inference accuracy.
